evidence.name: Screen field: Which score this adds to
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Which score this adds to" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Which score this adds to
sections.description: Choose the number variable this answer adds points to, such as a quiz_score or lead_score total. Only Number-type variables appear here, so if the list is empty, create a number variable first. Use one shared score variable across all the screens you want to total up, with the points set in the score value field.
